messages:
emma_sales: FYI - FinServCo is evaluating a lift-and-shift from VendorX to Redwood. They need a short POC showing parity for streaming chat + function calls, identical JSON shape for choices[], and an estimate for 200M tokens/month. Also security packet for procurement. Can we list owners and blockers?

rafa_se: Quick clarifying q: are they using VendorX's exact streaming framing (partial_choice chunks) in prod? Any custom routing?

emma_sales: Yes, production uses partial_choice streaming and relies on `conversation_id` to tie sessions. They also use embeddings for vector search rev-scorer.

zoe_engineer: Tech: Redwood streams via SSE with data: events. We can add a compat shim that re-emits VendorX-style partial_choice frames and injects conversation_id from session cookie. Prototype exists in SE repo. Function-call payloads mostly map 1:1; slight arg naming diffs we'll map in the shim.

leo_infra: On residency/KMS: we can deploy a EU-dedicated Dedicated POC cluster (5 business days). Private deployment supports customer KMS/HSM; Hosted can offer customer-wrapped keys. Logs can be redacted or disabled per agreement.

mira_security: SQ flagged: SOC2 + pen-test, data egress limits, and log retention policy. I'll prepare the packet and confirm redaction language for the contract. Need Acme/FinServCo security contact for secure exchange.

emma_sales: Pricing context: VendorX quoted ~$15k/mo for their throughput. Presales, can we give a defensible anchor?

rafa_se: Ballpark: with batching + KV cache + 8-bit quant model on Dedicated, infra run-costs ~ $6k-8k/mo; platform & support ~ $2k. Recommend quoting $9k-10k/mo as a presales anchor. Note: streaming increases costs slightly vs non-streaming.

zoe_engineer: For validation I'll run a 300-prompt parity harness (short/long, function-call, multilingual). Normalize JSON, compare field-level diffs and embedding distance. I'll share results in 48 hrs.

redwood-bot: POC project created: redwood-poc-finserv-eu. SEs added and creds provisioned (vault). :white_check_mark:

leo_infra: I'll draft a one-pager on API differences (stream framing, conversation_id injection, function-call arg mapping, detected_language) and mitigation steps for their client.

emma_sales: Plan: Zoe delivers harness + sample diffs, Mira delivers security packet, Infra stands up POC, Rafa provides provisional pricing. Kickoff Wed 10:00 UTC. I'll send invite with their eng + procurement.

mira_security: Please DM their security contact and I'll share the redacted pen-test. Add procures@finservco.com to the invite.

emma_sales: Added procures@finservco.com. Thanks team. Any last blockers? :eyes:
